written: 2026-10-27, before any data was built, any model trained or any output looked at
author: Claude (Cowork session), approved direction by Ahmed: layer 3 generative fill
what: RUDRA layer 3: a Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B (Apache-2.0) LoRA that fills only fully clipped highlights and fully crushed shadows of a RUDRA master; composited so that no 8-bit code of the master's SDR view changes.
not_used: any development, validation, holdout or fresh-grade scene

sources: Poly Haven HDRIs G:/datasets/sources/polyhaven/*_2k.exr whose ph:<name> is a commercial train scene of the run05 registry
the other commercial train plates of the run05 registry (FXTD own footage, CC0/authored renders)
data.exclusions: tools/build_aces_scale_crops.evaluation_scenes (same as claude_scale_crops_20261027) plus every non-train registry scene; asserted
data.view: ACES 2.0 SDR 100 nits (Rec.709), OCIO built-in cg-config-v4.0.0_aces-v2.0_ocio-v2.5, 8-bit
data.exposure: FXTD native; others median AP1 luminance 0.18; offsets highlight {0,1,2,3}, shadow {-4,-3,-2}, random {-1..3}
data.noise: 30 % of clips: signal-dependent Gaussian, AR(1) rho 0.5 in time, before the view
data.mask: codes >= tau_high (U{240..254}) or <= tau_low (U{1..10}), dilate 2, EMA 0.7; keep clips with 0.2 %..60 % masked
data.dev_split: 3 % of training scenes by hash (validation-loss monitor only)

training.objective: rectified flow matching, logit-normal sigma shifted 3; loss weight 1 + 4 inside the mask
training.optimiser: AdamW lr 1e-4 (200 warm-up), betas 0.9/0.999, wd 0.01, grad clip 1, batch 1 x accumulate 4, bf16 transformer, float32 LoRA
training.length: 8000 updates or 9.5 h (stop at the first 1000-update save after 9.5 h); THE LAST LoRA IS THE RESULT, no selection on the dev loss

gates.R: every frame of every evaluated master: rint(255*view(filled)) == rint(255*view(master)) on 100 % of pixels (float32 masters); untouched pixels bit-identical
gates.H: Poly Haven / FXTD truth clips not used in training (the frozen PH holdout and the fresh FXTD grade set v2 scenes): inside the highlight fill mask, mean |log2 Y_filled - log2 Y_truth| < the same for the unfilled master, 95 % bootstrap CI over clips excludes 0; and at -3 and -6 EV the PU21-encoded error inside the mask is lower than the master's
gates.S: the same clips at +3 EV: shadow-mask error no worse than the master's (CI upper bound <= +2 %); no shadow pixel lifted above its code edge (guaranteed by R)
gates.T: flicker excess of the filled region <= 0.02 EV over the truth on the competitor-pack clips (bright and dark) and the 2 generated clips
gates.A: the generated-clip review set: no visible seams between windows (frame-to-frame step at window joins <= 1.5x the median step)
gates.release: nothing is promoted to the app's default unless every gate passes; the app option stays labelled experimental
